thesis: AI capability keeps scaling; the physical supply chain behind it hits scarcity first.
chain: AI models -> accelerators -> HBM/memory -> networking -> data centers -> electricity -> cooling/power equipment

accelerators.bottleneck: GPU/ASIC supply and CoWoS packaging slots

memory.bottleneck: HBM/DRAM/NAND capacity; few suppliers, long fab lead times

datacenter_neocloud.bottleneck: Powered, permitted data-center shells and GPU cloud capacity

power_generation.bottleneck: Grid interconnect queues; firm, dispatchable power

power_cooling_equipment.bottleneck: Transformers, switchgear, liquid cooling, grid build-out labor
